people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Bezer
people.line: Levitical city of refuge in Reuben

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Golan
people.line: A city of refuge in Bashan, allotted to Manasseh.

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Reuben

translations.web: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
translations.bsb: And beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho, they designated Bezer on the wilderness plateau from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.
translations.kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
translations.asv: And beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
